description: The migration check: analyse a Google Image Charts / Image-Charts / QuickChart URL and report, parameter by parameter, what UrlChart will render, degrade, ignore or not support — plus the equivalent UrlChart URL. Computed from the URL alone: NOTHING is rendered and no request is made to the chart host. Use this before migrating an embed to find out what changes (for example a multi-axis URL that an alternative charts it only on a paid plan).

url.description: The full legacy chart URL, including https://.

name: check_legacy_chart_url
title: Check a legacy chart URL
